title: A week in Denver
summary: Seven days of mountain views and red rocks, green chile and craft beer, great museums and murals, with a day up in the foothills.
author: Nate Bird

places.name: The Brown Palace Hotel and Spa
places.notes: An 1892 hotel around a stained glass atrium, where every president since Teddy Roosevelt has stayed. Afternoon tea is a treat.

places.name: The Crawford Hotel
places.notes: Rooms upstairs in restored Union Station, with the train to the airport downstairs.

places.name: Limelight Hotel Denver
places.notes: A calm, modern hotel next to Union Station, with mountain views from the upper floors and a lively lobby bar.

places.name: The Ramble Hotel
places.notes: A small, stylish hotel in RiNo with a great cocktail bar, Death & Co, in the lobby.

places.name: Snooze, an A.M. Eatery
places.notes: The original location of the breakfast chain. Pancake flights and a long weekend wait.

places.name: Biker Jim's Gourmet Dogs
places.address: 16th Street Mall & Stout St, Denver, CO 80202
places.notes: Reindeer, elk and rattlesnake sausages with cream cheese and caramelized onions.

places.name: Denver Central Market
places.notes: A food hall in an old warehouse. Pizza, tacos and gelato, and you can drink while you browse.

places.name: Work & Class
places.notes: Latin and American comfort food by the pound in a shipping-container building. Lively and fun.

places.name: Rioja
places.notes: Mediterranean-inspired cooking on Larimer Square. One of Denver's best dinners.

places.name: Tavernetta
places.notes: Elegant Italian by Union Station from the team behind Boulder's Frasca. Book ahead.

places.name: Buckhorn Exchange
places.notes: Denver's oldest restaurant, since 1893, under hundreds of mounted heads. Steaks and game.

places.name: Sam's No. 3
places.notes: A classic diner since 1927. Get the Kickin' Green Chile, smothered on anything.

places.name: El Taco de Mexico
places.notes: A no-frills counter with legendary smothered burritos in green chile.

places.name: Rosenberg's Bagels & Delicatessen
places.notes: New York-style bagels, made with water treated to taste like New York's.

places.name: Little Man Ice Cream
places.notes: Ice cream served from a giant milk can. The line on summer nights is part of the fun.

places.name: Williams & Graham
places.notes: A speakeasy behind a bookcase in a small storefront. Some of the best cocktails in the country.

places.name: My Brother's Bar
places.notes: Denver's oldest bar, with no sign out front and classical music on. Order a JCB burger.

places.name: Wynkoop Brewing Company
places.notes: Colorado's first brewpub, opened in 1988 by a future governor. Pool tables upstairs.

places.name: Denver Union Station
places.notes: A grand 1914 station turned the city's living room, with bars, cafes and shuffleboard in the great hall.

places.name: Denver Art Museum
places.notes: Bold buildings and a strong collection of Indigenous and Western American art.

places.name: Clyfford Still Museum
places.notes: A whole museum of one abstract painter's work, in calm concrete galleries. Next to the art museum.

places.name: History Colorado Center
places.notes: Colorado's story, from Ute history to ski towns. The rooftop terrace has a mountain view.

places.name: Colorado State Capitol
places.notes: Stand on the 'mile high' step, then take the free tour up into the gold dome.

places.name: Molly Brown House Museum
places.notes: The Victorian home of the Titanic survivor, with guided tours of the rooms.

places.name: Larimer Square
places.notes: Denver's oldest block, strung with lights over the street. Good for a dinner and a walk.

places.name: Meow Wolf Convergence Station
places.notes: A huge, strange, walk-through art world. Allow three hours and touch everything.

places.name: Denver Museum of Nature & Science
places.notes: Dinosaurs, gems and dioramas, with the mountains framed in the windows behind City Park.

places.name: United States Mint at Denver
places.notes: A free tour of where the coins in your pocket were made. Book ahead online.

places.name: Coors Field
places.notes: Rockies baseball with mountain views. Look for the purple row of seats a mile above sea level.

places.name: Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre
places.notes: A concert stage between giant red rocks. Walk the trails by day, or catch a show at night.

places.name: Denver Botanic Gardens
places.notes: Gardens from around the world, including a calm Japanese garden. Summer concerts on the lawn.

places.name: City Park
places.notes: Lakes and lawns with the classic downtown-and-mountains view from the museum steps.

places.name: Washington Park
places.notes: Denver's favorite park for a run or a picnic, with two lakes and flower gardens.

places.name: Confluence Park
places.notes: Where Cherry Creek meets the South Platte. Start a bike ride or float down the creek in summer.

places.name: Chautauqua Park
places.notes: A meadow below the Flatirons with trails for every level, half an hour from Denver.

places.name: Buffalo Bill Museum and Grave
places.notes: A winding drive up Lookout Mountain to Buffalo Bill's grave and a sweeping view of the plains.
